# Simpl

> Simpl (simpl.pro) is the market intelligence partner for commercial building services. We find the buildings that need you, before your competitors know they exist. Simpl reads public records (inspection results, violation notices, certificates, permits, recertification and retrofit deadlines, federal inspection files), ranks the buildings in a client's territory that have a dated reason to need the client's trade, and hands the client's sales team who to call, with a link to the record behind every reason.

## Who it is for

- Elevator service and modernization companies: https://www.simpl.pro/industries/elevator-service
- Fire alarm and sprinkler contractors: https://www.simpl.pro/industries/fire-alarm-sprinkler
- Low voltage, fiber and telecom: https://www.simpl.pro/industries/low-voltage-fiber-telecom
- Roofing and facade contractors: https://www.simpl.pro/industries/roofing-facade
- Generator dealers and emergency power service: https://www.simpl.pro/industries/generators
- Concrete restoration and commercial construction: https://www.simpl.pro/industries/commercial-construction

## How it works

1. We read every record for the client's territory, every night. Records that are not online are requested under public records laws.
2. We rank the buildings by what can be seen: how serious the record is, how recent, how close the deadline. No black-box scores.
3. We hand the team who to call: the building, the owner on record where the source names one, the reason, the excerpt and the record link.

Sample account brief: https://www.simpl.pro/how-it-works#sample

## Pricing and terms

Pricing is set per territory and given on a 15-minute call. Terms: flat price per territory, month to month after setup, no credits, no lookup or usage caps, no auto-renew (annual prepaid renews only when the client says yes). https://www.simpl.pro/pricing
